photo.title: Planet Earth
photo.description: Earth is the fifth-largest planet in the solar system.

photo.title: Nebula Orion
photo.description: According to modern astronomers, the Orion Nebula is an enormous cloud of gas and dust, one of many in our Milky Way galaxy.

photo.title: Comet NEAT
photo.description: Comet C/2002 V1 (NEAT) is a non-periodic comet that appeared in November 2002.

photo.title: Planet Earth Alternate Take
photo.description: Earth is the fifth-largest planet in the solar system.

photo.title: Galaxy Andromeda
photo.description: Although several dozen minor galaxies lie closer to our Milky Way, the Andromeda galaxy is the closest large spiral galaxy to ours.

photo.title: Nebula Helix
photo.description: The Helix Nebula is a planetary nebula (PN) located in the constellation Aquarius.

photo.title: Planet Jupiter
photo.description: Jupiter is the fifth planet from the Sun and the largest in the Solar System.

photo.title: Galaxy Sombrero
photo.description: The Sombrero Galaxy is a spiral galaxy in the constellation borders of Virgo and Corvus, being about 9.55 megaparsecs (31.1 million light-years) from our galaxy, within the local supercluster.

photo.title: Galaxy Whirlpool
photo.description: The Whirlpool Galaxy is an interacting grand-design spiral galaxy with a Seyfert 2 active galactic nucleus.
